biden_switch_rate.label: Share of Biden 2020 voters who voted Trump in 2024 (validated voters, one-time 2024 survey)

switchers_per_reverse_switcher.label: Biden-to-Trump switchers for every Trump-to-Harris switcher

switching_share_of_shift_pct.label: Share of Trump's 2024 edge that came from voters switching sides (the rest came mainly from new voters and 2020 third-party voters)

much_worse_switch_rate_pct.label: Switch rate among Biden voters who, in 2024, rated the economy 'much worse' (one-time 2024 survey, weighted); a different measure from chart 04, which uses the 2022 rating in the panel

note: CES 2020-24 panel: 2024 recall of the 2020 vote checked against what the same people reported in November 2020.
